strings.zh: 您好,需要我送您回一之岛吗？{NEWLINE}每人次服务费500元。
strings.en: Hello. Would you like me to take you{NEWLINE}back to One Island? The fare is $500{CLEAR}per person.

strings.zh: 随时恭候您的光临。
strings.en: We’re always at your service.

strings.zh: 好的,请跟我来吧。
strings.en: Very well. Please follow me.

strings.zh: 抱歉,您身上的钱不够支付服务费。
strings.en: Sorry, you don’t have enough money to{NEWLINE}pay the fare.

strings.zh: 不跟我交换？{NEWLINE}切,真扫兴哪……
strings.en: You don’t want to trade?{NEWLINE}Tch, what a buzzkill...
strings.notes: US 0562/4 | tone review: 切,真扫兴 = annoyed scoff; US 'Aww...' replaced to follow the Chinese (D-0627)

strings.zh: 哟！{NEWLINE}和我交换的雪拉比{CLEAR}现在还好吗？
strings.en: Hey! How’s the Celebi you got in our{NEWLINE}trade doing?

strings.zh: 你是来四之岛旅行的吧？{SCROLL}旅途中可能会很疲劳,{NEWLINE}但是不用担心,{CLEAR}休息一下就好了。
strings.en: You’re here to visit Four Island, right?{SCROLL}Traveling can wear you out, but don’t{NEWLINE}worry. A little rest will fix that.

strings.zh: 祝你在四之岛玩得愉快。
strings.en: Enjoy your time on Four Island.

strings.zh: 水都群岛每年都会举行诸岛巡礼,{NEWLINE}到时候来参加巡礼的训练家,{CLEAR}都会经由这边的山洞登上天柱峰。
strings.en: Every year, the Alto Mare Islands hold{NEWLINE}the Island Pilgrimage. The Trainers who{CLEAR}come for it climb Sky Pillar Peak by way{CLEAR}of the cave over there.

strings.zh: 哈哈,你好啊旅人,{NEWLINE}我是四之岛的岛主。{CLEAR}过段时间之后,{CLEAR}我们水都群岛会举行诸岛巡礼活动,{CLEAR}你如果有时间的话一定要来参加啊,{CLEAR}会很有意思的。
strings.en: Ha ha, hello there, traveler. I’m the{NEWLINE}chief of Four Island. Before long, we’ll{CLEAR}be holding the Island Pilgrimage here in{CLEAR}the Alto Mare Islands. If you have time,{CLEAR}you’ve got to take part. It’ll be a lot{CLEAR}of fun.

strings.zh: 战槌龙『Raaa——pa！
strings.en: Rampardos: Raaa-pa!

strings.zh: 来,这个金珠给你。
strings.en: Here, have this Nugget.

strings.zh: 大叔我啊正在四之岛挖金珠,{NEWLINE}等我挖够了金珠换成钱,{CLEAR}就去关东地区买个房子定居。
strings.en: This old guy’s digging for Nuggets on{NEWLINE}Four Island. Once I’ve dug up enough{CLEAR}Nuggets to cash in, I’ll buy a house in{CLEAR}Kanto and settle down.
strings.notes: RV005: voice: self-reference 大叔我 restored

strings.zh: 群岛居民培育精灵的方法{NEWLINE}还是比较传统的,{CLEAR}他们竟然没人用过{CLEAR}西鲁夫公司开发的培育药品。{CLEAR}我想在这里推广这些{CLEAR}先进便捷的培育药品,{CLEAR}但我带的货量实在是太少,{CLEAR}如果你有这些药品的话{CLEAR}能给我一些吗？{CLEAR}我用这附近的特产跟你换。
strings.en: The islanders here raise their Pokémon{NEWLINE}the old-fashioned way. Not one of them{CLEAR}has ever used the raising medicines{CLEAR}Silph Co. developed! I want to spread{CLEAR}these advanced, convenient medicines{CLEAR}here, but I brought way too{CLEAR}little stock.{SCROLL}If you have any of these medicines,{NEWLINE}could you give me some? I’ll trade you{CLEAR}local specialties from around here.

strings.zh: 一套努力值药品换一套特产
strings.en: EV medicine set for specialty set

strings.zh: 一套降努力值树果换一套特产
strings.en: EV-lowering Berry set for specialty set

strings.zh: 算了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 你带的货物数量不够啊,{NEWLINE}等凑齐一套之后再来交换吧。
strings.en: You don’t have enough of the goods.{NEWLINE}Come back and trade once you’ve got a{CLEAR}full set.

strings.zh: 哇,你竟然带了这么多货,{NEWLINE}真的是太好了。{CLEAR}这些是水都群岛的特产,{CLEAR}作为交换请收下吧。
strings.en: Wow, you brought so much stock! That’s{NEWLINE}great. These are specialties of the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands. Please take them{CLEAR}in exchange.

strings.zh: 哇哦！您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吧。{NEWLINE}居然能在水都群岛遇到您{CLEAR}真是太走运了。
strings.en: Whoa! You’re League Champion {VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}aren’t you? I can’t believe my luck,{CLEAR}meeting you in the Alto Mare Islands.

strings.zh: 我是来四之岛寻宝的石头爱好者,{NEWLINE}我听说您从紫苑镇的富士老人那里{CLEAR}得到过一块神秘石头。{CLEAR}如果您不介意的话,{CLEAR}能把这块石头卖给我吗？{CLEAR}我愿意出10万元购买！{SCROLL}要把石头卖给他吗？
strings.en: I’m a stone enthusiast here on Four{NEWLINE}Island to hunt for treasure. I heard{CLEAR}Mr. Fuji of Lavender Town gave you a{CLEAR}Mystery Stone. If you don’t mind, could{CLEAR}you sell it to me? I’ll pay $100,000{CLEAR}for it!{SCROLL}Sell him the stone?
strings.notes: #20-#66: Mr. Fuji's mysterious stone; sold to the collector, then bought back from the lady with a Misdreavus for an Eviolite.

strings.zh: 您什么时候想卖石头了,{NEWLINE}随时欢迎来找我。
strings.en: Whenever you want to sell the stone,{NEWLINE}come see me anytime.

strings.zh: 您身上好像没有那块{NEWLINE}传说中的石头啊。
strings.en: You don’t seem to have that legendary{NEWLINE}stone on you.

strings.zh: 没错,就是这块石头！{NEWLINE}在我们石头爱好者中的人气可高了。{CLEAR}谢谢你愿意把它卖给我,{CLEAR}这里是10万元,请您收好。
strings.en: Yes, this is the stone! It’s hugely{NEWLINE}popular among us stone enthusiasts.{CLEAR}Thank you for agreeing to sell it to me.{CLEAR}Here’s $100,000. Please take it.

strings.zh: 谢谢您愿意卖石头给我,{NEWLINE}这应该是我这辈子收集到的{CLEAR}最珍贵的石头了。
strings.en: Thank you for selling me the stone. It{NEWLINE}must be the most precious stone I’ll{CLEAR}ever collect in my life.

strings.zh: 听说水都群岛要举行诸岛巡礼活动,{NEWLINE}我也想参加活动试试身手。
strings.en: I hear the Alto Mare Islands are{NEWLINE}holding the Island Pilgrimage. I want to{CLEAR}take part and test my skills too.

strings.zh: 哦哦哦！诸岛巡礼开始了,{NEWLINE}我要挑战四之岛的海岛洞穴,{CLEAR}但是里面有点黑,{CLEAR}自己一个人进去好害怕啊……
strings.en: Ooh! The Island Pilgrimage has started!{NEWLINE}I’m going to take on the Island Cave on{CLEAR}Four Island. But it’s kind of dark in{CLEAR}there. I’m scared to go in by myself...

strings.zh: 诸岛巡礼已经结束了,{NEWLINE}我却没能挑战成功,{CLEAR}唉,看来以后还需要好好训练啊。
strings.en: The Island Pilgrimage is over, and I{NEWLINE}didn’t make it through. Sigh... Looks{CLEAR}like I need to train a lot more.

strings.zh: 诸岛巡礼已经结束了,{NEWLINE}但是锻炼不能结束。{CLEAR}你有时间跟我来场对战{CLEAR}锻炼一下吗？
strings.en: The Island Pilgrimage is over, but{NEWLINE}training never ends. Do you have time{CLEAR}for a battle with me?

strings.zh: 你希望单打还是双打？
strings.en: Would you like a Single or a{NEWLINE}Double Battle?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 好的！这次我不会再输了！
strings.en: All right! I won’t lose this time!

strings.zh: 啊,还是你技高一筹啊。
strings.en: Ah, you’re still a cut above me.

strings.zh: 你只带着1只精灵,{NEWLINE}可没有办法双打。
strings.en: You have only 1 Pokémon with you. You{NEWLINE}can’t have a Double Battle.

strings.zh: 你在诸岛巡礼时{NEWLINE}展现出来的实力很强嘛,{CLEAR}我很想再通过对战向你学习一下,{CLEAR}请问你现在有时间吗？
strings.en: The strength you showed in the Island{NEWLINE}Pilgrimage was amazing. I’d love to{CLEAR}learn from you through another battle.{CLEAR}Do you have time now?

strings.zh: 咱们这次是单打还是双打？
strings.en: Singles or Doubles this time?

strings.zh: 谢谢你不吝赐教！
strings.en: Thank you for the lesson!

strings.zh: 虽然输了,{NEWLINE}但感觉学到了很多东西。
strings.en: I lost, but I feel like I learned a lot.

strings.zh: 是冠军大人啊,{NEWLINE}上次在天柱峰没能跟您对战{CLEAR}我始终有点遗憾,{CLEAR}不知道您现在有没有空{CLEAR}让我更加直接地感受一下您的实力？
strings.en: It’s the Champion! I’ve always{NEWLINE}regretted not getting to battle you on{CLEAR}Sky Pillar Peak last time. Do you have{CLEAR}time now to let me feel your strength{CLEAR}more directly?

strings.zh: 哈哈好,就以单打定胜负！
strings.en: Ha ha, all right! Let’s settle it with a{NEWLINE}Single Battle!

strings.zh: 哈哈好,就以双打定胜负！
strings.en: Ha ha, all right! Let’s settle it with a{NEWLINE}Double Battle!

strings.zh: 哎呀呀,是我输了,{NEWLINE}真不愧是冠军大人。
strings.en: Oh my, I lost. Just what I’d expect{NEWLINE}from the Champion.

strings.zh: 这里是四之岛。{NEWLINE}高耸的天柱峰就坐落在这里。
strings.en: This is Four Island. Home of the{NEWLINE}towering Sky Pillar Peak.

strings.zh: 传说高耸入云的天柱峰上{NEWLINE}住着掌管天空的口袋妖怪。{CLEAR}要想召唤它现身,{CLEAR}必须要持有信物宝珠才行。{SCROLL}这种宝珠没有人见过,{NEWLINE}但根据城都地区秀力博士的说法,{CLEAR}距离天空最近的训练家{CLEAR}似乎在负责保管这颗宝珠。
strings.en: Legend says the Pokémon that rules the{NEWLINE}skies lives atop the cloud-piercing Sky{CLEAR}Pillar Peak. To summon it, you must hold{CLEAR}a special orb as a token.{SCROLL}No one has ever seen this orb. But{NEWLINE}according to Professor Hale in Johto, it{CLEAR}seems the Trainer who stands closest{CLEAR}to the sky is the one keeping it safe.

strings.zh: 我的隆隆石圆滚滚的很可爱吧？{NEWLINE}它是我在挖石头时遇到的,{CLEAR}当时我在锤石头却不小心锤到了它,{CLEAR}还把它打成了重伤,{CLEAR}从那之后我就开始照顾小拳石,{CLEAR}如今它也终于进化成隆隆石了。
strings.en: Isn’t my Graveler cute and round? I{NEWLINE}met it while digging for stones. I was{CLEAR}hammering a rock and accidentally hit{CLEAR}it, and I hurt it badly. Ever since, I’ve{CLEAR}looked after that Geodude, and now it’s{CLEAR}finally evolved into Graveler.

strings.zh: 隆隆石『Graaa——ve！
strings.en: Graveler: Graaa-ve!

strings.zh: 我为了给我们家梦妖{NEWLINE}选一块合适的石头佩戴,{CLEAR}特地来到了这座{CLEAR}盛产各种石头的四之岛。
strings.en: I came all the way to Four Island,{NEWLINE}where all kinds of stones are mined, to{CLEAR}pick the right stone for my Misdreavus{CLEAR}to wear.

strings.zh: 四之岛的石头可是很出名的,{NEWLINE}我要在这里多收集一些。
strings.en: The stones of Four Island are famous.{NEWLINE}I’m going to collect some more here.

strings.zh: 你好啊冠军大人,{NEWLINE}又有什么好石头要卖给我吗？
strings.en: Hello, Champion. Got any more good{NEWLINE}stones to sell me?

strings.zh: 我想回购富士老人的那块石头
strings.en: Let me buy back Mr. Fuji’s stone
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I want to buy back Mr. Fuji’s stone'

strings.zh: 我没什么石头可卖了
strings.en: I have no more stones to sell

strings.zh: 那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: That’s a real shame.

strings.zh: 哎？想要回购石头？{NEWLINE}可是那块石头已经被我{CLEAR}以100万元的价格{CLEAR}卖给那边那位贵妇了。{SCROLL}你如果想要石头的话得找她谈谈了。
strings.en: Huh? You want to buy the stone back?{NEWLINE}But I already sold it for $1,000,000 to{CLEAR}the lady over there.{SCROLL}If you want the stone, you’ll have to{NEWLINE}talk to her.

strings.zh: 唉？你想要买我的那颗神秘石头？{SCROLL}不行不行,这种稀有的石头{NEWLINE}我可是花了好多钱才买到的,{CLEAR}怎么可能再卖给你呢。
strings.en: Huh? You want to buy my Mystery Stone?{SCROLL}No, no. I paid a lot of money for such a{NEWLINE}rare stone. How could I sell it to{CLEAR}you now?

strings.zh: 怎么样才肯把石头给我？
strings.en: What do you want for the stone?
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'What would it take for you to give it{NEWLINE}to me?'

strings.zh: 那就算了
strings.en: Forget it, then

strings.zh: 你还真是执着于这颗石头啊。{NEWLINE}那这样吧,我一直在找一颗{CLEAR}名为进化奇石的神奇石头,{CLEAR}据说有的精灵带上它{CLEAR}就能获得超强的力量。{CLEAR}但是这颗石头非常稀有,{CLEAR}我找了好多地方都没有找到。{CLEAR}如果你能拿一颗这种石头来跟我换,{CLEAR}我就把这颗虽然稀有{CLEAR}但不知道能干什么用的石头给你。
strings.en: You really are set on this stone,{NEWLINE}aren’t you? Tell you what. I’ve been{CLEAR}looking for a marvelous stone called an{CLEAR}Eviolite. They say some Pokémon gain{CLEAR}amazing power when they hold it. But{CLEAR}it’s very rare, and I haven’t found one{CLEAR}anywhere I’ve looked.{SCROLL}If you bring me one of those stones in{NEWLINE}exchange, I’ll give you this stone. It’s{CLEAR}rare, but I have no idea what it does.

strings.zh: 要把身上的进化奇石给她吗？
strings.en: Give her the Eviolite?

strings.zh: 哇！真的是进化奇石,{NEWLINE}跟我在朋友那看到的一模一样。{CLEAR}太好了,这样一来我的梦妖{CLEAR}即使不进化也能变得很强了！
strings.en: Wow! It really is an Eviolite, just like{NEWLINE}the one I saw at my friend’s place.{CLEAR}Wonderful! Now my Misdreavus can get{CLEAR}really strong even without evolving!

strings.zh: 找了这么多地方,终于找到{NEWLINE}最适合我们家梦妖的石头了。
strings.en: After searching so many places, I’ve{NEWLINE}finally found the perfect stone for{CLEAR}our Misdreavus.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『您好,听说您从别人那里{NEWLINE}买到一块神秘石头。{CLEAR}那块石头原本是我卖给他的,{CLEAR}我现在想从您这里买回来可以吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hello. I heard you bought a{NEWLINE}Mystery Stone from someone. I was the{CLEAR}one who sold it to him in the first place.{CLEAR}Could I buy it back from you now?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这颗石头对您来说{NEWLINE}可能只是一个收藏品,{CLEAR}但对我来说还有别的意义。{CLEAR}如果可以的话,请您告诉我{CLEAR}怎么样您才肯把石头给我呢？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: To you, this stone may just be{NEWLINE}a collector’s item, but it means{CLEAR}something more to me. If you could,{CLEAR}please tell me what it would take for{CLEAR}you to give it to me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『正好我身上带着进化奇石,{NEWLINE}就送给您吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: As it happens, I have an{NEWLINE}Eviolite with me. It’s yours!

strings.zh: 那么按照约定,{NEWLINE}这块神秘石头就给你吧。{CLEAR}希望有朝一日你能破解它的用法。
strings.en: Then, as promised, this Mystery Stone{NEWLINE}is yours. I hope you figure out what{CLEAR}it’s for someday.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『其实是这样的,{NEWLINE}我现在需要卖给你的那颗神秘石头。{CLEAR}你能把它再卖给我吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Here’s the thing. I need that{NEWLINE}Mystery Stone I sold you. Could you{CLEAR}sell it back to me?

strings.zh: 梦妖『Miiii——dre！
strings.en: Misdreavus: Miiii-dre!

strings.zh: 从这里往前就可以登上{NEWLINE}四之岛的天柱峰了,{CLEAR}不过在那之前,{CLEAR}你还要先打赢我！
strings.en: Ahead of here, you can climb Four{NEWLINE}Island’s Sky Pillar Peak. But before{CLEAR}that, you have to beat me!

strings.zh: 好久都没见过{NEWLINE}你这么强的挑战者了。{CLEAR}你完全有实力战胜我们的岛主,{CLEAR}请过去吧！
strings.en: I haven’t seen a challenger this strong{NEWLINE}in a long time. You’re more than strong{CLEAR}enough to beat our island chief. Please{CLEAR}go ahead!

strings.zh: 从这里登上天柱峰,{NEWLINE}就能看到天上飘荡的白云,{CLEAR}可壮观了！
strings.en: If you climb Sky Pillar Peak from here,{NEWLINE}you can see the white clouds drifting{CLEAR}across the sky. It’s spectacular!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,我带着精灵蛋爬上了天柱峰哦,{NEWLINE}这一趟走下来可真够累人的。{CLEAR}我现在要带着蛋去其他地方转转咯。
strings.en: Heh heh, I climbed Sky Pillar Peak with{NEWLINE}my Pokémon Egg! What a tiring trip. Now{CLEAR}I’m going to take the Egg around to{CLEAR}other places.

strings.zh: 一颗精灵蛋,{NEWLINE}把手放上去似乎能感受到{CLEAR}里面微微跳动的脉搏。
strings.en: A Pokémon Egg. When you put your hand{NEWLINE}on it, you can almost feel a faint pulse{CLEAR}beating inside.

strings.zh: 水都群岛的岛民们{NEWLINE}认为天柱峰是离天最近的地方,{CLEAR}因此每年的诸岛巡礼中,{CLEAR}登上天柱峰成为了一个{CLEAR}必不可少的环节。
strings.en: The people of the Alto Mare Islands{NEWLINE}believe Sky Pillar Peak is the place{CLEAR}closest to the heavens. That’s why{CLEAR}climbing Sky Pillar Peak is an essential{CLEAR}part of the Island Pilgrimage{CLEAR}every year.
